name: RUNX family transcription factor 2

function.text: RUNX2 encodes runt-related transcription factor 2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity and DNA-binding transcription factor activity. It participates in SMAD protein signal transduction and negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to cleidocranial dysplasia 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Educational atlas reports rearrangement context; exact allele and disease applicability require review.
